_comment: Horde AI (PLAN.md §7.3). Hours are game hours (divided by world speed). Fear: a horde beaten at a hex leaves fear there (perDefeat plus perUnitLost for each of its fallen); fear shrinks to decayPerWave of itself every time a wave spawns and is forgotten below minimum. Hordes add targetWeight × fear to a target's cost and pathWeight × fear to each feared hex they would cross. The Holy City is always a target, counted like the nearest settlement: holyCityExtraCost on top of its road (0: it is struck when no village is closer; a tie goes to the village). A personality's erratic share jitters target costs (monsters choose wildly). Raid or raze: the first raze.graceWaves waves only raid; after that, a horde that beats a village razes it when it has the time (raze.hours of its rampage left) and the strength (at least raze.minStrength times the help that could come), and its faction's razeBias + log2(strength) - weakenedPenalty (when under half its first numbers) reaches raze.threshold; otherwise it raids. A raid recruits raid.recruitShare of its first strength. The rampage clock starts when the horde first reaches a target; until it runs out the horde moves on to the next village it hasn't hit, then settles into a bandit camp. Razed villages are ruins; rebuilding costs ruins.rebuildCostShare of everything that stood, over ruins.rebuildHours. A player left with only ruins gets a refugee camp on the nearest free settleable hex at least refugeeCamp.minDistance from the Holy City; hordes raid refugee camps but never raze them. Hordes reaching the Holy City fight its guard (growing guardGrowthPerWave each wave) and, if they win, take damagePerUnit Sanctity per survivor; at 0 the run is lost.
